name: craft-context
description: craft-context governed context and repository tools

interface.shortDescription: Provide governed knowledge, memory, experience, and repository context.
interface.longDescription: Resolve scoped Knowledge, Memory, and routeable Experience in one bounded receipt, and prepare a repository index when needed. It never grants execution authority or silently imports private chat history.
defaultPrompt: Use Craft Context to resolve bounded project knowledge, memory, and verified procedures. Prepare repository structure only when relevant, explain the receipt and source versions, and write durable memory only on my explicit request.
